request_basis: 用户要求补充W08，缺乏实际数据时考虑跳过，未定参数参考通常数值；不放松研究门槛。

future_confirmation.start_rule: First eligible trading session after accepted candidate freeze and completed preregistration; no retroactive start.
future_confirmation.end_rule: Before launch, fix the first exchange-calendar session satisfying both 252 scheduled sessions and 12 calendar months; never extend after viewing results to chase a pass.
future_confirmation.missing_data_rule: At the frozen end, insufficient valid dates means inconclusive, not passed; no zero-fill or retrospective date deletion.

sources.supports: Walk-forward and stress-test methodology and bias caveats, not numerical pass thresholds.
Do not annualize sub-year returns; 36 monthly observations for specified three-year ex-post standard deviation reporting. Does not prescribe 252 days as proof of factor effectiveness.

AQR Style Premia Alternative Fund targets 10% volatility with expected forecast target range 8%-15%. One global long-short fund, not the average of Chinese ETF strategies or a realized volatility guarantee.
